description: PrettyTree renders tree-shaped data as readable ASCII diagrams. Useful in #inspect output, log lines, or anywhere you want to see a tree's structure at a glance instead of a nested inspect dump. Works out of the box with nested-array trees, and extends to any node type via a small Adapter/Formatter…
